follow-up time: Up to infant age (death or otherwise)
finding: Pregnancies with nonobstetric surgery during gestation were associated with increased risks of prematurity, low birth weight, low Apgar scores, neonatal and infant death compared to pregnancies without surgery.
mod_finding: Pregnancies with nonobstetric surgery during gestation had a higher risk of cesarean section compared to those without surgery.

birth_weight: Low birth weight was measured as an outcome
